title: The Andhra Pradesh Inland Waterways Authority Act, 2023.
full_text: The Andhra Pradesh Inland Waterways Authority Act, 2023. ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ దేశీయ జలమార్గముల ప్రాధికార సంస్థ చట్టము, 2023 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202318 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2023-05-01 Act Year: 2023 Short Title: The Andhra Pradesh Inland Waterways Authority Act, 2023.
